#!/bin/bash

# Pre-commit hook to check staged files

# Function to check staged files
check_staged_files() {
    echo "🔍 Checking staged files..."
    
    # Get list of staged files
    staged_files=$(git diff --cached --name-only)
    
    # Check if there are any staged files
    if [ -z "$staged_files" ]; then
        echo "⚠️  No files are staged for commit."
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "📂 Staged files to be checked:"    
    echo "$staged_files"
    
    # Initialize error counter
    error_count=0
    
    # Loop through each staged file
    while IFS= read -r file; do
        if [ -n "$file" ]; then
            echo "\n📄 Checking: $file"
            
            # Example check: Ensure no debug statements in code files
            if [[ "$file" == *.sh || "$file" == *.js || "$file" == *.py ]]; then
                if grep -n "debug" "$file" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                    echo "❌ Found 'debug' statement in $file"
                    error_count=$((error_count + 1))
                fi
                
                if grep -n "console.log" "$file" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                    echo "❌ Found 'console.log' statement in $file"
                    error_count=$((error_count + 1))
                fi
            fi
            
            # Example check: Ensure no large files are staged
            file_size=$(wc -c < "$file")
            if [ $file_size -gt 1000000 ]; then  # 1MB limit
                echo "❌ File $file is too large ($file_size bytes)"
                error_count=$((error_count + 1))
            fi
        fi
    done <<< "$staged_files"
    
    # Report results
    if [ $error_count -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "\n✅ All checks passed!"
        return 0
    else
        echo "\n❌ Failed: $error_count issue(s) found in staged files."
        echo "🔧 Please fix the issues above and stage the files again."
        return 1
    fi
}

# Execute the check
check_staged_files
exit $?
